question: Should the npm release workflow accept SHA-only `extended-stable` refs for validation-only preflight while keeping real publish constrained to exact release tags?
rationale: The code review can verify the guard shape, but this is a protected release workflow surface owned by release operators.

options.title: Approve guarded preflight mode
options.body: Land after release-manager review confirms publish remains tag-only and the refreshed exact head is green.

options.title: Ask for another guard assertion
options.body: Request an extra workflow test proving `PREFLIGHT_ONLY` is absent from publish validation/recheck steps before merge.

options.title: Defer until another rehearsal
options.body: Keep the PR open until the next extended-stable rehearsal produces another live SHA-only preflight run.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded preflight mode
recommendation.body: Land after release-manager review confirms publish remains tag-only and the refreshed exact head is green.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the concrete recent owner of the extended-stable release workflow and authored the related merged implementation history.
